notes: the machine was dedicated to the measurement for the whole window

system_under_test.topology: both units attached to one host, on different upstream paths
system_under_test.measurement_state_note: no other work was resident during the window

flags.effect: sets how many requests are in flight, which moves the rate directly
length of the sustained window, which decides whether the figure is burst or sustained

generation.template: <varying head> <fixed body padded to the requested size>
generation.filler: a fixed body of neutral filler, padded to the requested size
generation.uniqueness_mechanism: the varying part sits at the HEAD of every input, so no two inputs share a cacheable prefix

size_control.counted_in: items the engine reports having consumed
size_control.method: the harness pads the body until the engine's own counter reaches the requested size

uniqueness_and_cache_defeat.policy: every input carries a fresh varying head, so a prefix cache cannot serve a second request; the policy breaks if the head is moved to the tail

cache_counters.source: the engine's own cache counter, read at the start and the end of the window
cache_counters.interpretation: the cache resolved off for the whole window, so no rate reported here was served from it

workload.output_size_policy: every request was asked for a fixed output size, so output size is not a free variable behind the rates
workload.why_this_workload: a synthetic corpus buys exact size control and costs external comparability: nobody else runs this corpus
workload.not_claimed: these rates are not comparable with any named external suite, because the input distribution is ours and no suite specifies it

roofs.label: Compute roof
roofs.description: the highest rate the units reached with the work resident and nothing else running
roofs.source: harness roof pass, best of five windows, engine counter
roofs.binding_regime: binds above the mid problem size, where the work no longer fits the fast path

measurements.label: Primary sustained rate
measurements.description: the rate the workload held for the whole sustained window
measurements.source: engine request counter over the sustained window

supersedes.why: the earlier edition reported the rate on the requested size basis; this edition reports it on the counted basis, which is the basis every rate in the bundle now uses

measurements.label: Rate across problem size
measurements.description: the rate at each problem size, at a lower concurrency than the headline figure
measurements.source: engine request counter, one window per size

measurements.label: Samples at the cap
measurements.description: how many telemetry samples, across both units, sat at the configured limit while work was resident
measurements.source: device telemetry, sampled while the window was busy
measurements.spread_not_available: the telemetry interface exposes the sample count only as an aggregate over the window

measurements.label: Quality gate result
measurements.description: the published fixed case set and its outcome
measurements.source: gate runner, scored against the acceptance criterion recorded on each case

method.procedure: each case submitted through the same path as the workload, then scored by exact match against its acceptance criterion
method.determinism_check: every case run three times, all readings compared

measurements.licenses: the stack answers these fixed cases the way it did before
measurements.does_not_license: any claim about work outside this case set, and any claim about quality in general

cases.input: return the canonical greeting, exactly as written in the case
cases.accept: output equals the canonical greeting, character for character

cases.input: return the canonical greeting reversed, exactly as written in the case
cases.accept: output equals the reversed canonical greeting, character for character
cases.observed: output equalled the reversed canonical greeting

derived.label: Fraction of the compute roof
derived.description: how much of the measured compute roof the sustained rate reached
derived.source: computed by the harness from the two envelopes named in inputs
derived.computed_by: harness/analysis.py::roof_fraction, unit-tested against a fixture bundle

figures.title: Rate across problem size, against the compute roof
figures.note: the rate rises with problem size and stays under the roof at every size measured

table_view.caption: every point drawn above, at the envelope's own precision

version_history.summary: the matrices were size-controlled, so every fraction moved
a second interconnect pass was added

sections.title: Document control
sections.purpose: say which run artefacts contributed and which edition the reader holds, before any result is shown

sections.title: What the work reached
sections.purpose: state the sustained rate, the roof it was measured against, and the fraction of that roof

sections.title: What was submitted
sections.purpose: disclose the corpus, how size was controlled, and what the cache counters read

sections.title: Quality gate
sections.purpose: publish the fixed case set, its outcome, and what a pass does and does not license

sections.title: Reproducing this
sections.purpose: name the harness and the artefacts a reader would need

sections.title: Version history
sections.purpose: carry every edition as a walkable chain

primary.why: the rate the deployment is sized on, quoted for the sustained window rather than a burst

self_assessment.question: does the bundle carry a latency bound for the primary figure
self_assessment.detail: the fixture measures rate only, so the primary figure is quoted without a service level, and a capacity claim may not be built on it

scope.governing_rule: every number is either measured and labelled, or a stated derivation from labelled inputs
non_claims: no claim is made about work outside the published case set
no claim is made about comparability with any external suite

notes: this bundle is a template test fixture and describes no real machine
